build_method: 任务模板程序生成, BioPython计算理想答案, 规则化生成近错干扰项

eval_feature_en: Fifteen biological-sequence subtasks, zero-shot chain-of-thought, explicit decline option, and human comparison

drawio_review_note: Aligned with LAB-Bench arXiv:2407.10362 Sections 2-4 and Appendix SeqQA task descriptions; official Future-House/LAB-Bench repository. SeqQA is the sequence-manipulation category of LAB-Bench, containing 750 multiple-choice questions across 15 subtasks involving DNA, RNA, proteins, PCR, restriction enzymes, open reading frames, cloning, and basic sequence properties. Most items are generated programmatically. Task-specific scripts and BioPython compute ideal answers, while distractors are deterministic near misses or incorrect transformations such as shifted fragment lengths, truncated open reading frames, nearby amino acids, or perturbed GC content. The official release separates public data from a protected test or canary portion. In the paper's baseline evaluation, models answer with zero-shot chain-of-thought and no tools, with an explicit decline option. Text completions are parsed into choices. Accuracy measures correct answers over all questions, precision measures correct answers over attempted questions, and coverage measures attempted questions over all questions. Results are reported by subtask over three runs and compared with human researchers.
